description: This source file is a shell script (`create-dmg.sh`) used to create a styled DMG disk image on macOS. It sets up parameters, performs cleanup, copies application files, configures the visual presentation with AppleScript, and finalizes the DMG image.

methods.name: to_applescript_list4
methods.description: Converts a string of four space-separated values into a comma-separated list for AppleScript configuration.

methods.name: to_applescript_pair
methods.description: Converts a pair of space-separated values into a comma-separated pair for AppleScript commands.
